extensionDescription.message: Hand the page you are reading to Cognia. Nothing is read until you capture it.

pairIntro.message: Open Cognia on this computer, go to Settings → Connectivity → Pairing → Browser Companion, and generate a pairing code.

pairOriginLabel.message: Before connecting, add this extension origin to Settings → Connectivity → Local host → Browser access

pairWrongFormat.message: That does not look like a Cognia pairing code.

pairVersionMismatch.message: This code is from a newer Cognia. Update the extension.

pairPermissionNeeded.message: Cognia needs permission to reach 127.0.0.1 on this computer.

pairPermissionDenied.message: Without that permission the extension cannot reach Cognia at all.

pairExpired.message: This pairing code has expired. Generate a new one in Cognia.

pairNotLoopback.message: This code is for a different computer. Generate one in Cognia on this computer.

pairMalformed.message: This code is incomplete or damaged. Copy it from Cognia again.

captureEmpty.message: Nothing captured yet. Use the toolbar button, the shortcut, or the right-click menu on a page.

captureRestricted.message: This page cannot be captured. Only ordinary http and https pages can be sent.

captureFullUrlHint.message: Off by default: query strings often carry session tokens and search terms.

instructionPlaceholder.message: What should Cognia do with this?

submitDisabled.message: Cognia has switched off browser submissions. Turn Browser access back on in Settings → Connectivity → Local host.

submitUnknownTarget.message: That destination is no longer available in Cognia. The list has been refreshed — pick one again.

submitUnknownWorkspace.message: That workspace is no longer available in Cognia. The list has been refreshed — pick one again.

submitParamsMissing.message: This template needs every required value filled in.

submitTooLarge.message: This capture is larger than Cognia accepts. Send your selection instead of the whole page.

submitPayloadMismatch.message: This capture changed since the first attempt. Capture the page again and resend.

reasonNoRuntime.message: Waiting for Cognia's runtime — try again once it is running.

reasonRefused.message: Cognia refused this message. Try again, or open the task to see why.

recentEmpty.message: Tasks you start from here will appear in this list.

resultTruncated.message: Shortened — open it in Cognia to read the rest.

stopDrivenElsewhere.message: Cognia is driving this task right now. Stop it there.

stopFailed.message: This task could not be stopped.

hostOffline.message: Cognia is not responding on this computer.

hostOfflineHint.message: Open the app and check Settings → Connectivity → Local host → Browser access.

storageError.message: The extension could not read its local data.

storageErrorHint.message: Try again. If this continues, reload the extension from the browser's extension settings.

revoked.message: This browser is no longer paired with Cognia.

incompatible.message: This extension is too old for the Cognia on this computer.

disconnectConfirmDetail.message: This browser's key is deleted and it will need a new pairing code. Cognia keeps listing it until you revoke it in the device console.

disconnectDoneHint.message: Its key is gone from this browser. To remove it from Cognia as well, revoke it in the device console.

clearLocalConfirmDetail.message: Forgets the cached appearance and the workspace you last chose. You stay paired, and your tasks stay in Cognia.

captureNoGrant.message: Cognia has no access to this tab. Click the toolbar icon on the page you want to send, or use the right-click menu.

notifyNeedsInput.message: A Cognia task needs your input

notifySiteQuestion.message: An agent wants to act on $HOST$. Answer in the Cognia side panel.

agentBarActing.message: Cognia is acting in this tab

agentBarPaused.message: You have control — Cognia is paused

agentModeLabel.message: Let agents act in this browser

agentModeHint.message: Asks Chrome for access to all sites. Cognia still asks you before acting on each site.

agentSitesDenied.message: Chrome did not grant access to sites, so agent mode stays off.

agentPermissionDenied.message: Chrome did not grant that permission.

agentSocketRefused.message: refused — check this browser in Cognia's settings

agentDriveAllowed.message: The Cognia Owner allows agents to act in this browser.

agentDriveNotAllowed.message: Agents cannot act here yet: allow it for this browser in Cognia → Settings → Companion.

agentDownloadsLabel.message: Let agents see and manage downloads

agentCookiesLabel.message: Let agents read and clear cookies

attachRegionHint.message: Drag over the screenshot to choose a region.

attachFailed.message: The screenshot could not be taken.

attachTooLarge.message: That file is larger than Cognia accepts.

attachFullPageCut.message: The page is very long; only its first part was captured.

attachImageUnreadable.message: The image could not be read, so only its address is sent.

attachImageUnsupported.message: That image type cannot be attached; only its address is sent.

attachPdfUnreadable.message: The PDF could not be read.

attachUploadFailed.message: An attachment could not be uploaded: $REASON$

blockedHostsHint.message: Pages on these sites and their subdomains are never read.

blockedHostInvalid.message: That is not a site address.

captureBlocked.message: You have set this site never to be captured.

captureEditText.message: What will be sent (you can trim it)

captureStale.message: This tab has moved on since it was captured.

draftDroppedAttachments.message: Your draft was restored without its $COUNT$ attachments; add them again if you need them.

notificationsHint.message: Shows a system notification while the panel is closed.

pagesFull.message: No more pages fit in one request.

pagesNoTabs.message: No other web tabs are open in this window.

pagesTabsDenied.message: Chrome did not allow listing tabs.

pagesOriginDenied.message: Chrome did not allow reading that site.

pagesReadFailed.message: That tab could not be read.

pagesOverBudget.message: Together these pages are more than Cognia accepts in one request; remove one or trim the text.

promptsEmpty.message: An empty instruction cannot be saved.

promptsTooLong.message: That instruction is too long to save.

promptsFull.message: You have saved as many prompts as fit.

quickPromptSummarize.message: Summarize this page: the main points, then anything I should act on.

quickPromptExplain.message: Explain this clearly, as if to someone new to the subject.

quickPromptTranslate.message: Translate this into my language, keeping the formatting.

recentLoadFailed.message: More tasks could not be loaded.

siteQuestionDetail.message: An agent wants to $ACTION$ on this site.

transcriptFailed.message: The transcript could not be read

agentSocketStatusOnly.message: Connected for status only. Update Cognia and the extension to enable browser actions.

agentSocketIncompatible.message: Protocol incompatible. Update Cognia and the extension, then reconnect.
